metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle launched extreme distance by explosion
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a truck, dune buggy, or other vehicle catapulted an extreme distance or height by an explosion that is too small to justify the force?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle or aircraft clips into ground
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a jet, plane, or vehicle partially embedded in the terrain — stuck halfway into the ground, rotating while buried, or with parts visibly below the surface?

metamorphic_relations.name: Destroyed wreckage floats in air
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a destroyed vehicle wreckage (burning helicopter, blown-up car) hovering or floating in the air instead of resting on the ground?

metamorphic_relations.name: Structure spins uncontrollably
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a structure like an antenna, satellite dish, or mounted object spinning wildly or continuously rotating, possibly dragging an attached player along with it?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle explodes from minor or no contact
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a motorcycle, moped, or vehicle detonate violently from a low-speed collision or minor wall contact that should cause only minor damage?

metamorphic_relations.name: Object stuck in infinite falling animation
metamorphic_relations.check: Does an object enter a falling animation and remain stuck in it even after touching ground, unable to stand or move properly?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle duplicates when delivered
metamorphic_relations.check: When calling a rebel drop or delivery vehicle, does a second identical vehicle spawn on top of or next to the first one?

metamorphic_relations.name: Wingsuit collision launches an object vertically
metamorphic_relations.check: Does lightly clipping a tree, pole, or small object launch the object like NPC or the main character straight upward or backward at extreme speed?
